# vinhnt-sdk Documentation Index

> Machine-readable index for AI tools and documentation generators

## API Reference

### Core Layer
- [core](api/core.md) - Agent kernel, orchestration, workflows
- [schema](api/schema.md) - Types, contracts, validation
- [config](api/config.md) - Configuration loading
- [llm](api/llm.md) - LLM providers, token metering
- [tools](api/tools.md) - Built-in tools and tool system
- [sandbox](api/sandbox.md) - Process sandboxing
- [guard](api/guard.md) - Circuit breaker, rate limiting
- [session](api/session.md) - Session persistence
- [permission](api/permission.md) - Permission system
- [step-executor](api/step-executor.md) - Tool execution engine
- [provider](api/provider-openai-compatible.md) - OpenAI-compatible provider

### Extension Layer
- [plugin](api/plugin.md) - Plugin SDK
- [knowledge](api/knowledge.md) - Memory, context compression
- [event](api/event.md) - Event bus
- [mcp](api/mcp.md) - Model Context Protocol
- [trace](api/trace.md) - Telemetry, cost tracking
- [security](api/security.md) - Prompt injection protection
- [lsp](api/lsp.md) - Language Server Protocol
